title: fix(app-shell): clear dateRange and exportOptions when a report switches to Joined
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb8C2BwXpb9gUHV68debZjbR)_

Fixes #29195

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim 6574419052.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 报表属性里把「报表类型」切换为「联合」时,除了原来清掉的数据集、度量、行、列、图表和排序,现在同一次修改里也清掉「日期范围」(`dateRange`)和「导出选项」(`exportOptions`)。
- **为什么改**:联合报表不接受这两个键,而切换后表单会把「期间与导出」整节隐藏。原来带着这两个键的报表切到联合后保存会被服务端拒收,拒收落在一个页面上没有任何控件能改的位置,作者无法自行修复。
- **风险与回滚**:只改类型切换到联合那一个补丁,且只清报表上本来就有的键;切回非联合类型不会恢复它们,非联合类型之间切换完全不变。没有新文案、没有规范改动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` 的 `JOINED_CONTAINER_CLEARED_KEYS`;新测试 `ReportDefaultInspector.joinedClearsRefused-29195.test.tsx` 里的 "SPEC AS JUDGE" 用例(由 `ReportSchema` 判定清掉的键是否恰好等于规范拒收的键)。
- **两分钟验证**:Studio 打开一个设置了日期范围或导出选项的汇总报表,把报表类型改为「联合」并添加一个块:保存成功,保存的报表里没有 `dateRange` 与 `exportOptions`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`JOINED_CONTAINER_CLEARED_KEYS` gains `dateRange` and `exportOptions`.** `ReportSchema`'s joined arm refuses both on the container whatever their value, `{}` included (#26548), and the report form's "Period & export" section is hidden on a joined report. The type picker's switch to Joined cleared the other six refused keys (objectui#10746) and kept these two, so a report carrying either one was sent and refused at a key no visible control reached. Both are now cleared in the same patch, the same way: an own key holding `undefined`, which the wire omits, and only when the draft carries the key.
- **The list is not a second hand-kept copy of the spec's rule.** The spec exports no list of the refused keys, so the new test makes `ReportSchema` the judge: a report carrying every top-level key a non-joined report can carry is switched to Joined through the inspector, and the keys the patch clears must equal the keys `ReportSchema` refuses on the type-only switch, after which the report must parse. A coverage case holds that fixture against the spec's own property list, so a key the spec adds later must join the fixture (or the named exclusion set, with its reason) and the parse then decides whether the switch must clear it.
- Switching back to a non-joined type restores nothing, and switching between two non-joined types keeps both keys. `runtimeFilter`, `drilldown` and `description` travel through the switch untouched.

No spec, i18n or export change.

## Tests

- `ReportDefaultInspector.joinedClearsRefused-29195.test.tsx` (new, 7 cases): the maximal matrix fixture parses (instrument); coverage against the spec's property list, excluding `blocks`, `protection`, the ADR-0010 envelope keys (`MetadataProtectionFields`) and `overrides` (`OverrideDeclarationFields`), both read from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`; the spec-as-judge case above; the card's case (a summary report with `dateRange` and `exportOptions` switched to Joined saves without them and `ReportSchema` accepts the save); an empty `dateRange` and `formats: []` are cleared too; Joined back to Summary brings neither back; Matrix to Summary keeps both.
- `ReportDefaultInspector.joinedClearsBinding-10746.test.tsx`: the comment on its six-keys constant now says those are the six its draft carries and points at the new file for the whole list. No assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- The card asks that "the server accepts the save". The test's verdict is `ReportSchema.safeParse` on the JSON-encoded draft, which is the schema the metadata save door validates a report with. It was not measured against a running server.
- The coverage pin's exclusion set reads two of its groups from the spec (`MetadataProtectionFields`, `OverrideDeclarationFields`); `blocks` and `protection` are named by hand with their reason.

## Verification

All on head `42c8f2b1` (base `origin/main` `45e9b2f1`, which contains `1e4841a2`).

<details><summary>New tests, and the ablation that shows they fail on main's list</summary>

- `vitest run` on the new file and the 10746 file: 2 files, 15/15 passed.
- Ablation with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, deleting the two new entries from `JOINED_CONTAINER_CLEARED_KEYS` (which leaves main's six-key list; anchor 1 to 0, blob `da0eaccf` to `c8803708`): 4 failed, 3 passed. The failures are the spec-as-judge case, the card's case, the empty-values case and the back-switch case. The three that pass are the instrument, the coverage pin and the non-joined control, which do not depend on the list. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Sweep, type-check and gates</summary>

- Test sweep under the verify lock: every ui test file naming `ReportDefaultInspector` or `JOINED_CONTAINER_CLEARED_KEYS`, plus the 29022 and 27785 report hold files: 20 files, 131/131 passed.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65/65 tasks, exit 0 (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`).
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 34 derived families, all exit 0, including `check-sdui-manifest`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (run against this body) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files passed, 2 skipped). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- Narrowing: the whole app-shell vitest suite is CI's Test UI; it was not run locally.

</details>
